0.description: The assigned venture is no longer available. It will be abandoned and your ventures reimbursed.

1.description: Unable to use <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>. You must first assign a class for your retainer.

2.description: Unable to use <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>. Your retainer has already attained level <hex:022003E80303>.

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LVUP_CAP_PLAYER
3.description: Your retainer cannot exceed your own level.

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ASK_PLAYER_LVSYNC
4.description: You can only advance your retainer as far as level <hex:022003E80203>, to match your current level. Do you wish to proceed?

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LVUP_NO_ITEM
5.description: You do not have <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203> in your possession.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE2
10.description: Nothin' fer ye to worry about.

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE4
12.description: Yes? <sigh> I hope this doesn't take long...

13.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
13.description: You wish to see how a master handles a bazaar?

16.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
16.description: What's it to be this time, love?

18.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
18.description: I'm so sorry to keep you waiting, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. So very, very sorry.

19.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
19.description: Quickly now, I've places to be.

20.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
20.description: Well, if it ain't my favorite client! Always a pleasure, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>!

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
22.description: What's on the agenda, chief? Deprivin' saps o' their hard-earned gil?

23.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE3
23.description: I have come. You may proceed.

24.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE4
24.description: Oh, hello there. To what do I owe the pleasure?

25.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE5
25.description: I am come to conduct business, and only business.

26.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
26.description: You look to be in good health, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. How may I assist you this fine <hex:02082EE3E90C0DFF14020810E3E90C05FF04657665FF056D6F726E03FF1302080FE3E90C12FF04646179FF046576650303>?

27.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
27.description: What is it you would have me do, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>?

28.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
28.description: Usually, it's me doin' the summons and others doin' the waitin'.

29.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE3
29.description: Is there something that I can help you with?

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
30.description: Oh, why must you summon me at a time like this...?

31.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
31.description: I'm sure there is a perfectly good explanation for this summons.

32.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
32.description: You know, I thought you might be along to summon me. You may rest assured that I am ready and eager to serve.

33.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
33.description: Hail to thee, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Your humble servant has heard your summons.

34.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
34.description: Greetin's and salutations, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>. Pray speak yer desires, an' I'll do me damndest to see 'em done.

35.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE3
35.description: I was wondering when you'd get around to calling me.

36.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
36.description: Mind if we keep this brief? I've got a pretty little thing that's waitin' for me.

39.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE1
39.description: Here I am, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>, as per your request.

41.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
41.description: I never miss a chance to line these pockets.

42.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
42.description: Well, this is unexpected! What'll it be?

45.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE1
45.description: How may I be of serrrvice, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>?

46.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
46.description: It's a war out there, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. You have no idea.

49.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
49.description: I presume you did not summon me solely for the pleasure of my company.

50.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
50.description: Just the <hex:020821E905FF0C66616972206D616964656EFF1068616E64736F6D652066656C6C6F7703> I was hoping to see! Tell me your heart's desire.

51.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE1
51.description: I hope your catcall is not one of disapproval.

53.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
53.description: A cat's ears do not miss much―least of all a summons.

54.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
54.description: Curiosity called the cat. What do you have for me today?

56.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
56.description: I was just thinking of you!

57.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
57.description: What need have you of me today, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>?

58.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
58.description: Bwahahaha! Ye got work needs gettin' done? Just point me in the right bloody direction.

60.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
60.description: Hey there─hic─<hex:020810E905FF066D69737379FF056D61746503>! Care to join me fer a pint?

61.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
61.description: Couldn't come no quicker. Where's the work?

62.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
62.description: I came runnin' soon as I heard the bell! Ye need somethin', chief?

64.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE2
64.description: Ye got somethin' fer me, cap'n?

66.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
66.description: Let's keep this short and sweet, shall we?

67.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
67.description: This wouldn't be necessary if you entrusted your financial affairs to me.

68.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
68.description: So─sellin', buyin', drinkin', whorin'? What's it to be today?

69.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
69.description: Greetings, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. How may I be of service?

74.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
74.description: We work the market stalls,♪<hex:02100103>And our uniforms are pretty;♪<hex:02100103>We are sober men and true,♪<hex:02100103>And attentive to our duties!♪

75.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
75.description: <hex:020815E905FF084D79206C616479FF084D79206C6F726403>. What would you ask of me?

78.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
78.description: Hey, it's...it's you! Hello again, you!

79.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
79.description: I-It's not like I want to sell your items or anything.

80.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
80.description: What do you have for me? Come on, come on! Don't be shy!

81.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE1
81.description: If that is all, I will take my leave now, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>.

85.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
85.description: I believe thanks are in order.

88.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
88.description: Don't you worry 'bout a thing. I got this.

90.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
90.description: If there is nothing else, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, I'll be going now.

91.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
91.description: Is that all? Very well, until next time.

92.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
92.description: Oh, will that be all today? Very well, but promise me you'll come back soon!

93.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE1
93.description: As always, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, it has been an honor and a privilege.

94.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
94.description: You can count on me, chief─I know how to get things done.

96.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE4
96.description: I swear it shall be done. Eventually.

98.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
98.description: Capital! I shall carry out your orders forthwith.

99.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
99.description: I humbly await your next summons, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.

100.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
100.description: Don't leave me alone for too long, hear?

102.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
102.description: That will be all, yes? Then if you would excuse me...

103.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
103.description: I believe that concludes our dealings for now.

104.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
104.description: Are you certain you don't desire anything else? Anything at all? Very well, I shall take my leave.

105.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
105.description: Your every whim shall be swiftly carried out with due care and consideration.

106.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
106.description: Shouldn't take more than a moment, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.

108.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
108.description: Thank the gods we're finished. I've got plans to put my hands in places I've never seen...if you know what I mean.

112.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
112.description: Blessin's o' the Twelve upon ye.

113.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
113.description: May Nald'thal see fit to fatten our pockets!

114.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
114.description: Very good, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>! Your wish is my command, and so forth.

115.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE5
115.description: You know how to reach me.

116.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE6
116.description: Is it time for good-byes already? I'm going to miss you...

118.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
118.description: The markets may be a bleedin' battlefield, but I'm a godsdamned soldier. You can count on me, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

120.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
120.description: Why so serrrious? <sigh> So it goes.

121.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
121.description: I hardly think that warranted my personal appearance, but what is done is done.

122.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
122.description: Then I have satisfied your every need? Excellent! I do so take pleasure in servicing my clients.

124.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
124.description: Right then, let's get on with it!

125.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
125.description: There is no call for concerrrn.

126.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
126.description: When the master's away, the cat will play.

128.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
128.description: You don't want to be with me anymore? <sniffle>

129.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
129.description: I shall carry out your wishes as instructed, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

130.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
130.description: Bwahahaha! I'm in yer bazaar, sellin' yer wares!

132.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
132.description: Awww, bugger. Reckon I best get to work...

134.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
134.description: Go and grab yourself some shut-eye, chief. You look terrible!

135.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE1
135.description: Will that be all for today, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>? Understood.

138.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
138.description: Not exactly how I was hopin' to spend my day, but I suppose it can't be helped.

139.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
139.description: Ours is not to reason why. Ours is but to do and die.

140.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
140.description: Ever the consummate professional, I see. Another time, then.

141.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
141.description: If there is nothing else, then I shall take my leave.

142.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
142.description: Is that all? Guess I'll be on my way, then.

143.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
143.description: Any last requests? Very well. Heh heh heh... Ahem.

144.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
144.description: Ah, yes, of course. Duty calls!

145.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
145.description: You are finished with me, then?

146.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
146.description: Here today and gone tomorrow;♪<hex:02100103>Yes, I know─♪<hex:02100103>That is so!♪

147.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
147.description: If ever you have need of me, just ring.

150.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
150.description: Finished already? Guess that's that, then.

151.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
151.description: You're leaving already? Fine, then! I-It's not like I wanted you to stay or anything.

153.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_RETAINER_LEAVE_1
153.description: If you need aught else, I shall be waiting.

178.description: You cannot assign your retainer the <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103> job until they have achieved level <hex:022003E80303>.

206.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_CLASS_EXPLAIN_FISHER

215.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ASK_RETURN_WITH_BUYBACK
215.description: Your retainer will be unable to process item buyback requests once recalled. Are you sure you wish to proceed?

216.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_CURRENCY_CHANGE1
216.description: A venture promissory note cannot be used as is; you must first redeem it for ventures. The amount of ventures you possess is shown in the Currency window.

218.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE2
218.description: Easy now, easy. I'm on it.

221.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
221.description: I shall see to things from here.

224.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
224.description: Hah! I'll be back afore you know it.

225.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE3
225.description: If that is what you would ask of me.

227.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
227.description: Your enterprise is in capable hands, I assure you.

230.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
230.description: No need to worry, chief─this is where I shine.

233.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE5
233.description: Good. I prefer to work alone.

234.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
234.description: Ahhh, I do so enjoy the occasional excursion!

235.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
235.description: As you ask, so shall it be done, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

236.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
236.description: Work to be done, eh? All right, then.

238.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
238.description: A venture? <hex:021A020203>Now<hex:021A020103>? Well, if you insist.

239.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
239.description: I am well aware of how this works.

240.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
240.description: That sounds like fun! You'll be joining me, yes? <hex:021A020203>No<hex:021A020103>? Oh.

244.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
244.description: Hope you ain't expectin' me to rush. I wanna take it nice and slow.

245.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE5
245.description: I think I can manage from here.

246.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE6
246.description: I'll do it, I'll do it!

247.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE1
247.description: It is an honor to serve you, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>.

248.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
248.description: Is that all? A triflin' task!

249.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
249.description: If there's profit to be made, I'll make it.

250.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
250.description: My every waking minute will be spent working on your behalf, et cetera.

251.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE5
251.description: Fine...for now. But you're asking a bit much, considering what I'm paid.

253.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE1
253.description: Excellent decision, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Venturrres are my specialty.

254.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
254.description: A special solo mission? Hells, why didn't you say so sooner! Of course I'll do it!

256.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
256.description: Business. Always business with you. Fine...

257.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
257.description: Leave me to my task, and we shall both be satisfied.

258.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
258.description: You will be most pleased with the result. I guarantee it!

260.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
260.description: Ah, I was in the mood for a jaunt outside!

262.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
262.description: I'll start now, if that's what you want.

263.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE5
263.description: Not quite <hex:021A020203>ad<hex:021A020103>venturin', but it's close enough.

264.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
264.description: I'll do anything you say, exactly as you say.

265.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
265.description: I shall not keep you waiting overlong, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

266.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
266.description: Bwahahaha! So that's what this is about! I'll handle it!

269.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
269.description: I can go now, right? Great.

270.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
270.description: I'll give it everything I've got, chief!

272.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE2
272.description: Ye picked the right woman fer the job, cap'n!

274.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
274.description: Oh, for the love of─ Really? Godsdammit.

275.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
275.description: I see you finally have the good sense to grant me greater autonomy.

276.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
276.description: Oho, so it's venturin', it is! This ought to be fun.

277.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
277.description: Neither rain nor sleet nor ferocious beasts shall keep me from my task.

278.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
278.description: Venture, eh? Ain't nothin' to it.

279.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
279.description: Oh, I'll get busy. I'll get very busy, indeed.

280.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
280.description: What? I mean, I'm flattered you think I can handle it, but...

281.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
281.description: I don't recall this being part of my contract...

282.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
282.description: A simple retainer, lowly born,♪<hex:02100103>Unlettered and unknown,♪<hex:02100103>Who toils for bread from early morn,♪<hex:02100103>Till half the night has flown!♪

284.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE2
284.description: Sure, why not? I'll give it a go!

286.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
286.description: I'll do it! I'll rob the─ I mean, er, what you said.

287.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
287.description: A v-venture!? Great! It's not like I would rather spend time with you or anything.

288.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ACCEPT_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
288.description: Oh, a challenge! Far be it from me to deny you!

289.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE1
289.description: I pray this meets with your satisfaction, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>.

292.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE4
292.description: Let's not do this again for a while, shall we?

293.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
293.description: Do not behave as though you are not impressed.

296.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
296.description: How do you like me now, love?

299.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
299.description: Of course it was a success. Did you doubt me?

300.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
300.description: I think that went well, don't you?

302.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
302.description: A rousin' success, if I do say so myself.

305.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE5
305.description: I trust you have no complaints? Good.

306.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
306.description: What I wouldn't give to do this all the time!

308.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
308.description: One day it'll be me givin' the orders.

309.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE3
309.description: Let me know when you want me to handle another.

310.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
310.description: A thoroughly pedestrian result, I'm afraid. I would understand if you decided not to assign me ventures henceforth.

313.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
313.description: Your humble servant hopes that you find the fruits of his labor acceptable.

314.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
314.description: Could be better, but could be worse.

316.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
316.description: I knew I could satisfy your needs.

319.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE1
319.description: My only regret is that I could not return sooner.

321.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
321.description: 'Twas a most profitable venture, I'd say.

322.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
322.description: Always a pleasure to serve, and so on and so forth.

324.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE6
324.description: Some of my finest work yet!

325.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE1
325.description: It is an honor to serrrve, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

328.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
328.description: Why don't we both take it easy for a while?

329.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
329.description: And with that, we can move on to more important matters.

330.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
330.description: Was it everything you hoped it would be?

332.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
332.description: Just what ye wanted, am I right?

335.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE5
335.description: And that's the end of that chapter.

337.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
337.description: If you require aught else, you need only ask.

340.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
340.description: Why don't we toast our success with a pint or two?

341.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
341.description: If you want, I can undertake another one right now.

342.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
342.description: It's all there, chief. Ye have me word.

344.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE2
344.description: A good haul, all in all.

347.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
347.description: You yourself could do no better.

349.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
349.description: I pray that you are pleased with the result, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

350.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
350.description: Bet you weren't expecting <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> now, were you?

351.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
351.description: Ah, for the days when ventures were a gentleman's pursuit...

352.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
352.description: If you don't mind me saying, I think I did rather well.

353.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
353.description: I will be expected to do this again, I gather.

354.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
354.description: Can I survive this overbearing,♪<hex:02100103>Or live a life of mad despairing,♪<hex:02100103>My proffered goods despised, rejected?♪<hex:02100103>No, no, it's not to be expected!♪

356.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE2
356.description: All's well that ends well, wouldn't you say?

358.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
358.description: All acquired in accordance with local laws. <wink> <wink>

359.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
359.description: Alright, take yer shite and quit leerin' at me arse.<hex:02100103>...What? Ye can't seriously expect me to humor yer fetishes all the time, can ye?

360.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_COMPLETE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
360.description: Hardly my finest work, but I'm not ashamed to say I did it.

361.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_INTRO_1
361.description: You can now send your retainers afield on procurement expeditions known as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>ventures<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

362.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_INTRO_2
362.description: Before you can do so, however, you must first assign them a class.

363.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_INTRO_3
363.description: After summoning a retainer, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>assign retainer class<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu to begin.

364.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_CLASS_1
364.description: Your retainer cannot undertake ventures until you assign his or her class.

365.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_CLASS_2
365.description: This can be any one class, with the exception of those of the Disciples of the Hand.

366.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_CLASS_3
366.description: Your retainer's class determines which ventures he or she can embark upon.

367.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_CLASS_4
367.description: Please be advised that you cannot assign your retainer a class you have not yet unlocked.

369.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_FIRST_CLASS_2
369.description: You must now equip a main arm to your retainer.

370.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_FIRST_CLASS_3
370.description: Select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>view retainer attributes and gear<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu to proceed.

372.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_SECOND_CLASS_2
372.description: Please be advised that your retainer must be equipped with a main arm in order to undertake ventures.

373.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_CLASS_RESET_1
373.description: If you wish to assign your retainer a different class, you must first reset his or her current class.

374.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_CLASS_RESET_2
374.description: If necessary, recall your retainer and remove all gear to proceed.

375.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_EQUIP_1
375.description: You can equip any item in your inventory or Armoury Chest to your retainer, so long as he or she meets the requirements.

376.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_EQUIP_2
376.description: Equip a main arm to your retainer to proceed.

377.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_FIRST_WEAPON_1
377.description: You have equipped a main arm to <hex:022903EA0203>!

378.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_FIRST_WEAPON_2
378.description: Your retainer is now duly prepared to undertake ventures.

379.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_FIRST_WEAPON_3
379.description: Select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>assign venture<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu to proceed.

380.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_RETAINER_TIP_1
380.description: You do not have any ventures in your inventory and therefore cannot assign your retainer a venture.

381.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_RETAINER_TIP_2
381.description: Ventures can be acquired through a variety of methods such as exchanging company seals, fulfilling leve objectives, and completing allied society quests.

382.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_RETAINER_TIP_3
382.description: If you possess a venture promissory note, you may redeem it for ventures through a Calamity salvager or a retainer.

383.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_CLASS_EXPLAIN_START
383.description: As you may recall, the ventures your retainer can undertake are determined by his or her class.

384.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_VENTURES_1
384.description: There are two main types of ventures which you can assign your retainer.

385.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_VENTURES_2
385.description: Hunting, Mining, Botany, and Fishing constitute one type, in which you specify an item for your retainer to procure.

386.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_VENTURES_3
386.description: Exploration ventures constitute the second type, in which your retainer will scour the terrain of your choosing for (hopefully) precious items.

387.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_VENTURES_4
387.description: However, your retainer will not undertake a venture without first receiving due compensation.

388.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_VENTURES_5
388.description: Assigning a venture requires a payment in a unique currency of the same name─<hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>ventures<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

389.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_VENTURES_6
389.description: Ventures can be acquired through a variety of methods such as exchanging company seals, fulfilling leve objectives, and completing allied society quests.

391.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_FIRST_VENTURE_2
391.description: To confirm the time remaining until a venture is complete, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> under Duty from the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>main menu<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ventures<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

392.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_FIRST_VENTURE_3
392.description: You can also confirm the time remaining by selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>view venture report<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu.

393.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_FIRST_VENTURE_4
393.description: Should you wish to cancel the venture and recall your retainer, you may do so when viewing the venture report.

394.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_FIRST_VENTURE_5
394.description: However, please be advised that this is not necessary unless you wish to assign a different venture to your retainer.

395.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_FIRST_VENTURE_6
395.description: Even with a venture in progress, you can still entrust or withdraw items and gil, or sell items on the market.

397.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_FIRST_COMPLETED_2
397.description: To claim the fruits of your retainer's labor, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>view venture report<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu.

398.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_FINISHED_1
398.description: <hex:022903EA0203> has gained experience for completing a venture!

399.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_FINISHED_2
399.description: Like you, your retainer can gain experience and levels.

400.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_FINISHED_3
400.description: This, in turn, will allow your retainer to undertake a wider variety of ventures, yielding more desirable items.

401.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_TUTORIAL_FINISHED_4
401.description: Moreover, equipping additional gear to your retainer will increase both the quantity and quality of the items procured.

403.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_FORTUNE_TASK_UNLOCK_1
403.description: Your retainer is now experienced enough to undertake <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>quick exploration ventures<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

404.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_FORTUNE_TASK_UNLOCK_2
404.description: Select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>assign venture<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu to proceed.

405.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_FORTUNE_TASK_UNLOCK_3
405.description: Cut label, report if visible in game.

406.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_FORTUNE_TASK_1
406.description: Quick exploration ventures are brief assignments in which you dispatch your retainer without instruction.

407.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_FORTUNE_TASK_2
407.description: The items your retainer procures on these ventures can range from worthless to priceless.

408.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_FORTUNE_TASK_3
408.description: Moreover, the experience your retainer receives for completing a quick exploration venture is determined by the item procured.

409.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ABOUT_FORTUNE_TASK_4
409.description: Although it is impossible to predict the results of these ventures, the potential benefits should not be underestimated.

411.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE2
411.description: Ye know I'm in the middle o' yer venture, don't ye?

414.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
414.description: I trust there is a reason for this interruption?

415.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE6
415.description: I came as quickly as I could! What is it?

419.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
419.description: You couldn't have picked a more inconvenient time.

420.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
420.description: This better be worth my time.

423.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
423.description: Tell me you ain't got somethin' else for me, chief!

424.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE3
424.description: You have interrupted my venture. Proceed.

429.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
429.description: I'm a little busy, but what is it?

432.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
432.description: You do know how this works, right? You assign me a venture and then leave me to my task.

434.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
434.description: Hail to thee, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Your humble servant has set aside his task and hastened to your side.

435.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
435.description: Why'd ye call me back from me venture, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>?

436.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE3
436.description: This really isn't the best time.

437.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
437.description: I thought you were going to let me do this my way?

442.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
442.description: What's all this, then? Another chance for mischief?

443.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
443.description: <yawn> Just so you know, I was busy carrying out your tasks.

447.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
447.description: <hex:02080EE905FF054D697373FF0453697203>, you mustn't interrupt a soldier when he's on a mission!

449.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
449.description: You would burden me with additional tasks?

450.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
450.description: I thought I asked you to leave me to my task?

452.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE1
452.description: Forgive me, <hex:020811E905FF066D6164616DFF06736972727203>, but your catcall comes at an inopportune time.

453.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
453.description: Damn, just when I was startin' to enjoy meself!

454.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
454.description: A cat must be allowed to focus on her task.

455.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
455.description: You know I've not finished the venture yet, rrright?

456.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE5
456.description: Mind explainin' what this is about?

457.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
457.description: You know, you shouldn't summon me when I'm in the middle of a venture!

460.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE3
460.description: I've returned. What is it now?

461.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
461.description: Yeah? I was just enjoyin' a pint of─hic─uh, venturin'.

462.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
462.description: I've already got my hands full with this venture, but what is it?

464.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE1
464.description: I am at <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>'s beck and call.

468.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
468.description: I do not take kindly to interruptions.

469.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
469.description: Dammit, <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>, did ye forget I was out on a venture?

472.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
472.description: I have a life outside of <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, you know.

473.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
473.description: Let me tell you, it was absolute chaos out there. Quite frankly, I'm lucky to be alive! But I heard your call, and I knew I had to answer.

474.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
474.description: Worried about your venture? Don't be. Or have you some other reason for summoning me?

475.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
475.description: Fair moon, to thee I sing,♪<hex:02100103>Bright regent of the heavens,♪<hex:02100103>Say, why is everything♪<hex:02100103>Either at sixes or at sevens?♪

476.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
476.description: <hex:020815E905FF084D79206C616479FF084D79206C6F726403>. Is there aught else you require?

477.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE2
477.description: Can't say I was expecting this. What can I do for you?

479.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
479.description: Now, before you go jumping to conclusions, I'd just like to─ Oh! What can I do for you?

480.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
480.description: I-It's not like I was slaving away to make you happy or anything.

481.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
481.description: Somethin' else I can do for you, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>? Don't hold back now.

482.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE1
482.description: I shall return to my duties forthwith.

491.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
491.description: Guess I'll get back to that venture you assigned me.

492.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
492.description: That was not worth my time.

493.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
493.description: I'll take care of it, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, don't you worry!

495.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
495.description: Don't forget that I'm busy with this venture o' yours, chief!

499.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
499.description: Understood, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>! Oh, and fear not─the venture shall be completed on time!

500.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
500.description: I shall carry out <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>'s wishes to the best of my ability.

501.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
501.description: We finished? That venture's not goin' to finish itself.

503.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
503.description: If you would excuse me, I have a venture to finish.

504.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
504.description: Unless it is urgent, do not summon me during a venture again.

506.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
506.description: Do not hesitate to call on me again, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

509.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
509.description: I can't keep runnin' back to see you during these ventures, you know.

513.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
513.description: So much to do, so little time!

514.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
514.description: We'd best see to our respective tasks, eh?

515.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
515.description: Don't summon me, I'll summon you.

516.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE5
516.description: <sigh> I am not getting paid enough for this.

518.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE1
518.description: If there is naught else, I will rrresume my venture.

521.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
521.description: I suppose you want me to finish the venture too, don't you? <sigh>

522.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
522.description: Pray do not disturb me until the venture is complete.

523.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
523.description: Patience, my good <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>. Your venture will be finished in due time.

524.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE1
524.description: I shall rrreturn to my venture, <hex:020811E905FF066D6164616DFF06736972727203>.

527.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
527.description: I told you I'd take care of it, so stop worrying.

529.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
529.description: ...Try as I might, I can't stay mad at you.

530.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
530.description: Beg your pardon, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, but I must needs return to my venture.

533.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
533.description: Now then, if ye'll─hic─excuse me, I've got a venture what needs doin'!

534.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
534.description: All right. Let me handle it.

535.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
535.description: Happy to be of service, chief!

537.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE2
537.description: Ye still want me to carry out that venture, too, eh? Just checkin'.

539.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
539.description: 'Fore you ask, I've not forgotten about the venture.

540.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
540.description: If you want quality work, then leave me be.

542.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
542.description: Then if you would excuse me, I should return to my venture.

543.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
543.description: Right, then. I ought to be getting back to that thing of yours. “Venture,” was it...?

544.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
544.description: We shall meet again, old friend. But now I must steal away into the night.

545.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
545.description: If I don't make it back, I just want you to know... Eh, the hells with it. I'll tell you next time.

547.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
547.description: I must wander to and fro;♪<hex:02100103>But wherever I may go,♪<hex:02100103>I shall never be untrue to thee!♪

549.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE2
549.description: I suppose you'll be wanting me to finish that venture too, yes? Right, right. Don't know why I bothered asking...

551.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
551.description: Right, so, if anyone asks, I wasn't here, agreed? Cheers.

552.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
552.description: Go on, then. Go. It's not like I haven't more important things to do or anything.

553.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_LEAVE2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
553.description: Hm, hm. You've really nothin' else to ask? If you say so, then.

554.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE1
554.description: It pleases me to inform you that the venture is complete.

555.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE2
555.description: Hey, I finished that venture o' yours.

560.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE1
560.description: My <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>, the venture you bid me undertake has been finished.

561.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
561.description: I've got your goods, by the way. Let me know when you want 'em.

565.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
565.description: Good news, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>! The venture was a success!

568.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE3
568.description: I have come with your goods.

569.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE4
569.description: I took care of that venture for you.

570.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE5
570.description: You wish to hear my report?

573.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
573.description: This about the venture? I took care of it.

574.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE3
574.description: There you are! I've brought what you requested.

575.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
575.description: Oh, it's you. I suppose you'll want to hear about the venture.

576.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
576.description: Let's get on with it, shall we?

577.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
577.description: I've been waiting for your summons.

578.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
578.description: Hail to thee, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. You shall be pleased to hear that the venture was a success.

579.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
579.description: You want this stuff now or later?

581.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
581.description: Been a long time comin', but the venture's finally finished.

583.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE6
583.description: I did it, I did it!

584.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE1
584.description: Does <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> wish to hear my report?

585.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
585.description: 'Ello, dearie. I reckon you want your goods?

586.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
586.description: My pockets are bursting with your goods!

587.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
587.description: Well, this was to be expected. The venture, yes?

588.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE5
588.description: We should talk about the venture.

593.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
593.description: May I leave after making my report? No? <sigh>

594.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
594.description: I have prepared a formal report.

595.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
595.description: Am I to deliver my report now, or shall we discuss other matters first?

596.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE1
596.description: This cat has brought you a present, <hex:020811E905FF066D6164616DFF06736972727203>...

597.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
597.description: Ye want to hear the whole story, or just read the report?

598.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
598.description: 'Twas naught more than a rrroutine task.

599.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
599.description: I did my very best, just like I said.

600.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE5
600.description: Everythin' you need to know is in the report.

601.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
601.description: I have so much to tell you!

602.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
602.description: I have brought that which you desire, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

603.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
603.description: Bwahahaha! That venture was an <hex:021A020203>ad<hex:021A020103>venture, let me tell ye!

605.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
605.description: Venture? What in the seven hells are ye─ Oh, the <hex:021A020203>venture<hex:021A020103>! Aye, I did that.

606.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
606.description: Got a delivery for you. Just say the word.

607.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
607.description: Hey, chief! I got what ye asked for!

608.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE1
608.description: I have what <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403> requested in my possession.

611.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
611.description: Took a while, but the venture's done.

612.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
612.description: I had a mind to summon <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, actually.

613.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
613.description: This venturin' business ain't so bad!

614.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
614.description: It pleases me to inform you that the venture is complete.

615.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
615.description: Guess what I've got for you! No, really. Guess!

616.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
616.description: I renew my objection to that pointless endeavor. Informally now and by affidavit later.

617.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
617.description: You know, I think I'm starting to get the hang of this.

618.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
618.description: Per your orders, I have completed the venture...<hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>.

619.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
619.description: For he himself has said it,♪<hex:02100103>And it's greatly to his credit,♪<hex:02100103>That he is a retainer!♪<hex:02100103>He remains a retainer!♪

620.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
620.description: I have seen to the venture, <hex:020815E905FF086D79206C616479FF086D79206C6F726403>.

621.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE2
621.description: Oh, the tales I could tell you about that venture...

623.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
623.description: Heh, didn't expect him to put up such a─ Oh! Just the <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> I was hoping to see!

624.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
624.description: I-It's not like I risked life and limb to bring you back shiny baubles or anything.

625.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERCALL_00010_ENTER3_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
625.description: Oh, it has been a day such as you wouldn't believe!
